# Rilla Blythe

## Overview

- **Age:** Six years old  <sub>[v5 c1 P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003), [v5 c7 P16](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0016)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v5 c1 P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003)</sub>

## Appearance

Rilla is a fat, roly-poly little child with curly red hair and hazel eyes. She has long ruddy curls that can be styled sleek and round.

_Sources: [v5 c1 P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003), [v5 c7 P1](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0001)_

## Personality

Rilla takes great pride in fine clothing and elaborate accessories, occasionally strutting when dressed up. Her mother considers her to be somewhat vain.

_Sources: [v5 c7 P1](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0001), [v5 c7 P20](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0020)_

## Traits

- Vain  <sub>[v5 c7 P20](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0020)</sub>
- Proud of fine clothes  <sub>[v5 c7 P1](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0001), [v5 c7 P16](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0016)</sub>

## History

Rilla grew up at Ingleside as the youngest child of Anne Blythe. One day, Susan dressed her in her finest white dress, beaded slippers, and an elaborate hat to visit the manse. Proud of her outfit, Rilla strutted up the manse hill, which annoyed Mary Vance. After an encounter involving a codfish chase, Rilla's outfit was ruined and her pride was hurt, prompting Miss Cornelia to carry the sobbing child back home.

_Sources: [v5 c1 P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003), [v5 c7 P1](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0001), [v5 c7 P16](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0016), [v5 c7 P20](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0020)_

## Background by volume

- Youngest child of the Ingleside family  <sub>[v5 c1 P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003)</sub>

## Affiliations

- The Blythe family of Ingleside — Youngest daughter  <sub>[v5 c1 P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003)</sub>
